landing.description: The project's landing axis (Workflow DSL Specification, Plan Behaviour Axes), a convention of the repository; overrides the machine's plan_defaults.landing, overridden by a plan's own. Chosen in setup.configure-finalize and validated against the project there: landing.pull-request needs a provider, landing.main a base branch that the provider does not protect (derived fact base_branch_protected).

minimum_lane.description: deep: every plan runs the deep lane. light: the initial router decides and the light -> deep ratchet always applies. A forced light lane does not exist.

per_deliverable_verbs.description: Default ["compile", "module-tests"]. Server rule: each verb renderable by the project's effective canonical template.

final_verification.description: End-of-phase-5 verification steps; default derived from the build systems' verbs, never including default:mutation, which a project opts into here. Server rule: each id a shipped verification step or an enrolled project step.

lane.description: Lowest execution posture at which the optional step runs, or off. Server rule: only optional steps; a mandatory step is refused (mandatory_step_not_configurable).

params.description: Step parameters, validated by the server against the closed parameter schema of the step descriptor (FinalizeStepDescriptor.configurable).

order.description: Band position: a gap of the Settle band (3..10), the post-push band (12..69), the post-merge band (71..899), or 900..989; 11, 70, and 990..1099 are reserved for default steps. A collision with a default step's order and a source-mutating step at 70 or above are refused by FinalizePipelineValidator with the rest of the roster.

project_script_id.description: Server rule: enrolled with binding worker_kind finalize_step whose target is this step id; the step exists only when the unit, this descriptor, and the enrolment agree.
